title: Republic of Palau Second National Communication to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
temporal_coverage: Palau climate vulnerability assessments and historic conditions reported in 2013; includes projections to 2050 and 2100.
methodology: Melekeok climate assessment in a government UNFCCC communication, using field surveys and GIS.
limitations: Dated site study; proposed actions are not completed adaptation.

title: Palau Water Policy 2025–2045
temporal_coverage: Water-sector conditions and policy priorities in the 2025–2045 policy; includes historical 2016 drought and cited climate projections.
methodology: Government water policy synthesizing watershed and utility information.
limitations: Some climate projections date to the 2015 policy.

title: Disaster Risk and Climate Change Impact Survey in the Republic of Palau, Phase I
organization: Palau Bureau of Cultural and Historical Preservation and University of Oregon researchers; supported by UNDP through the EDCR project
temporal_coverage: Field survey conducted November 2019 and March 2020; includes flooding observed at Kayangel in April 2021.
methodology: Targeted ten-site cultural survey using field observations and standardized condition forms.
limitations: Selected heritage sites are not representative of Palau communities.

title: Palau’s Rock Islands Southern Lagoon launches resilience strategy
temporal_coverage: Resilience strategy launched in 2023; coastal fisheries management plan adopted in 2021.
methodology: UNESCO publisher report on the locally developed Rock Islands Southern Lagoon resilience strategy.
limitations: Short programme account; reports strategy activities and institutional arrangements, not independent impact estimates.

title: Palau: Office of Climate Change — climate impacts and the Palau Climate Change Policy 2025
organization: Office of Climate Change, Republic of Palau
temporal_coverage: Official page summarizing the 2025 climate policy and climate projections through 2040 and later.
methodology: Official climate-office page summarizing policy pillars and selected climate impacts and projections.
limitations: Underlying projection methods and emissions scenario are not provided on the page; policy pillars are commitments, not delivered results.

title: Enhancing disaster and climate resilience in Palau
organization: United Nations Development Programme, Pacific Office
temporal_coverage: Reports damage from Typhoon Haiyan in 2013 and El Niño drought in 2016; describes disaster-capacity activities in February 2020.
methodology: UNDP report on disaster impacts, preparedness partnership and planned post-disaster assessment training.
limitations: Historical programme account; training was scheduled, and reported losses are not a climate-attribution or conflict assessment.
